caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate cup centrally positioned on a plain, off-white background with a fine rectangular border. The cup is mostly brown with highlights and shadows rendered to give a metallic appearance. It features a rounded body that tapers slightly toward the base, and a single curved handle on the right side with decorative elements near its attachment points. The central section of the cup displays an embossed or carved floral design, consisting of intricate patterns and what appears to be a stylized flower or fruit surrounded by swirling forms. The inside of the cup and its rim are also visible, showing reflective highlights. In the lower right corner, the name “Yolande Delasser” is written within the bordered area.
title: Shaving Mug
